label

It is used to improve the usability of form components. The for attribute is used to find the corresponding ID or place the control under the tag. When the control is clicked, the corresponding control is triggered. The for attribute has a higher priority than the internal control. If multiple internal controls exist, the first control is triggered by default. Currently, the button, checkbox, radio, and switch controls can be bound.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
for String No ID of the bound control.

Sample Code

1. Label with for Attribute Binding

<view class="label-demo">
  <checkbox id="agree-cb" color="#2563eb" />
  <label for="agree-cb" class="bound-label">Tap this label text to toggle checkbox</label>
</view>
Page({ data: {} });
.label-demo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; }
.bound-label { color: #1e293b; cursor: pointer; }

2. Label Encapsulating Controls

<label class="enclosing-label">
  <radio value="r1" checked="true" color="#10b981" />
  <text style="margin-left: 8px; font-size: 14px;">Enclosed Radio inside Label</text>
</label>
Page({ data: {} });
.enclosing-label { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px; background: #fff; border-radius: 6px; }
